content.summary: The inspected Theorem 2 reduction is complete at the low-degree and support-normalization interfaces. A fresh bounded literal-set reconstruction recovered both motif domains, the whole-completion budget and all 74,761 six-subset exclusions. The revised maximum-degree root selection justifies the two cap5 branches. No missing implication or required revision was found; full proof-tree replay remains outside this round. Both supplied hashes match.

findings.statement: The eleven-point universe is justified only after the degree1/2 exclusions and moment bound. The two degree5 tree domains additionally require selecting a maximum-degree root when no degree6 point exists. The current manuscript and inspected tree scopes retain both requirements.
findings.disposition: Keep these reductions explicit; neither a finite candidate count nor a tree status supplies them. The fresh checks here reconstruct the degree2 exclusions and inspect tree domains, without replaying all tree nodes.

checks.scope: Ordinary degree1 exclusion and forcing of both degree2 motifs
checks.method: Read LOW15-R15-rho6-partial-status.md, Minimum degree and derived support bounds and Degree-two motifs, and R15-rho6-degree2-support-reduction.md. Re-derived the closed-neighbourhood identities and complete SF2 point-link consequences.
checks.observation: Since rho<=6 at size15, every closed neighbourhood has size>=9. If d(x)=1 in xyz, degree6 neighbours are impossible; N(xyz)=d(y)+d(z)-d(yz) forces degrees5,5 and codegree1, contradicting the leaf-middle structure of a five-edge SF2 link. With a degree6 neighbour, a degree2 point forces xab,xac,abc and three triangle stars, with x,a,b,c saturated. Without a degree6 neighbour, N>=9 and the same leaf-middle argument force d(y)=d(z)=5, codegrees xy=xz=1 and yz=2, the common w and two triangle stars. The later six triples must avoid the three saturated points. No finite support hypothesis enters these deductions.

checks.scope: Complete motif normalization, exterior budget and finite degree2 exclusions
checks.method: Executed a fresh literal-frozenset reconstruction without importing either producer or the saved checker. Generated triad identifications by overlap and old-subset/fresh-prefix choices, tested all single-triple extensions on three fresh labels, recomputed distinct old-pair capacities, and checked all six-subsets by literal sunflower conflicts.
checks.observation: Recovered91 degree6-neighbour motifs with6 survivors and no possible thirteenth triple, and78 other motifs with18 survivors. Every admissible exterior triple in the latter uses exactly one new point. Whole-completion budgets0,1,2,3 occurred3,7,6,2 times. Each of all74,761 candidate six-subsets contained two selected triples forming a sunflower with a fixed motif member. Since every exterior triple consumes one unit of one distinct old-pair capacity, the budget bounds all new points in the entire completion; relabelling those points into three fresh labels is exhaustive. The bounded combined check completed in approximately0.19 seconds.

checks.scope: Moment bound, eleven-point support and maximum-degree root choice
checks.method: Re-derived I=sum_v(binomial(d(v),2)-r(v)/2) and sum_v d(v)=45; checked the rational envelopes. A bounded independent enumeration of SF2 graphs on six labels checked the local minima r=1,2,4,6 for d=3,4,5,6. Compared manuscript section5.2 with R15-rho6-finite-closure.md, Literal mathematical target.
checks.observation: The double count subtracts exactly one excess count for each pair of triples meeting in two points. With minimum degree3, I>=60 and I<=285/2-7n force n<=11. Maximum degree4 gives I<=225/4<60. The revised manuscript chooses degree6 whenever available; otherwise a maximum-degree5 root justifies global cap5 in both five-edge-link branches. The local graph enumeration corroborates the imported SF2 structure; it is not presented as a new arbitrary-support classification.

checks.method: Inspected search_r15_rho6.py and replay_r15_rho6_tree.py scope/seed/candidate construction; decoded the three named compressed tree headers and checked their candidate lists against all triples of labels1 through10.
checks.observation: All three trees target15 with rho cap6, minimum used degree3 and padded universe11. Their complete root seeds have6,5,5 members; the respective global caps are6,5,5. Each candidate list equals all120 triples avoiding root0, so no additional root member is silently omitted: completeness follows from the chosen actual root degree. Unused padded labels are allowed, and replayer minimum-degree checks distinguish degree0 from used degrees1/2. Full child/colour replay was not executed in this round.
